title: Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering
title_zh: <用于高斯泼溅逆渲染的休闲闪光灯照明

paragraphs.en: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 当仅存在静态照明时，从照片中恢复几何结构、材质和光照具有高度的模糊性。 主动照明设置可以降低这种模糊性，但需要暗室或专用硬件。 相反，我们从随意的室内拍摄中协同利用静态照明和闪光灯照明，无论闪光灯是否开启，且两者均来自独立的视角。 闪光残差约束了反照率和 BRDF，而静态照明则捕捉到了闪光灯无法捕捉的掠角镜面高光。 在 2DGS 重建框架下，我们的主要贡献是一种以 GS 为锚点的漫射场：通过查询光栅化的 2DGS 深度来获取哈希编码的 MLP。 由于该漫射场仅依赖于世界位置，因此它在三维空间中具有视角一致性，并允许闪光残差驱动材质分解，而不是被跨视角的 alpha-混合漂移所吸收。 同时，我们使用延迟着色渲染静态照明，使其也能对材质分解进行监督。 在五个合成场景和三个真实室内场景中，我们的方法在漫射颜色、反照率和粗糙度等材质参数上优于六种近期的基线方法，并且在重照明任务中，其 PSNR 比次优基线提升了 4.17 dB。

paragraphs.en: Inverse rendering aims to recover the geometry, materials, and lighting of real-world scenes from image observations. Accurate estimation of these scene properties enables rendering from arbitrary viewpoints under novel lighting and allows editing of physically-based material attributes. However, the task remains highly challenging due to the high degrees of freedom (DoF) and inherent ambiguities in disentangling geometry, materials, and lighting, which complicate the optimization process.
paragraphs.zh: 逆渲染旨在通过图像观测恢复真实世界场景的几何结构、材质和光照。 准确估计这些场景属性，使得在新型光照条件下从任意视角进行渲染成为可能，并允许对基于物理的材质属性进行编辑。 然而，由于自由度（DoF）极高，以及在分离几何结构、材质和光照时存在固有的模糊性，这一任务仍然极具挑战性，这也使优化过程变得复杂。

paragraphs.en: To reduce the degrees of freedom, some works focus on reconstructing objects [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Here, we can simplify the unknown static lighting by modeling it as an environment map or a distant radiance field, and try to estimate it from scratch. However, this is still ill posed and, in scenes with complex lighting, these methods often struggle to disentangle lighting from material. We can also initialize the unknown lighting from captured images and jointly refine the lighting and material [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] , e.g., via explicit path tracing. Such methods can achieve higher-quality material reconstruction if the surrounding captured indirect lighting includes the emitters, but they tend to fail when only part of the scene lighting is observed. A third line of methods use controlled active lighting to aid material estimation. Under a one-light-at-a-time (OLAT) setup, they can achieve high-quality materials. To minimize ambient light contamination, they often operate in dark environments using point lights [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , area lights [ 12 ] , or LED arrays [ 13 ] , which limits their use in general scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了减少自由度，一些研究专注于重建物体 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 。 在这里，我们可以将未知的静态光照建模为环境贴图或远距离辐射场来简化，并尝试从头开始对其进行估计。 然而，这个问题仍然是病态的，在具有复杂光照的场景中，这些方法通常难以将光照与材质分离开来。 我们也可以从捕获的图像中初始化未知的光照，并联合优化光照和材质 [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] ，例如通过显式路径追踪。 如果周围捕获的间接光照包含了发射体，这类方法可以实现更高质量的材质重建；但如果仅观察到场景的一部分光照，它们往往会失败。 第三类方法则利用受控的主动光照来辅助材质估计。 在每次仅使用一个光源（OLAT）的设置下，它们可以实现高质量的材质。 为了最小化环境光的干扰，这些方法通常在黑暗环境中使用点光源 [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] 、面光源 [ 12 ] 或 LED 阵列 [ 13 ] ，但这限制了它们在通用场景中的应用。

paragraphs.en: We consider casual capture of indoor environments, and we will use both static and active lighting via flash lighting to achieve higher-quality inverse rendering (Fig. 1 ). In our setting, the flash-on and flash-off images can come from different viewpoints and in different numbers. In principle, static and flash lighting sources are synergistic in that both provide samples of the material specular lobe. For example, flash lighting can illuminate regions occluded from static lighting, while static lighting captures grazing-angle reflections that are difficult to observe using flash lighting alone. Flash lighting also aids in optimizing albedo, particularly when the static lighting is complex or non-white. Making effective use of these synergistic opportunities requires physically-based reconstruction of both static and active lighting components; e.g., past works isolate direct lighting from flash/no-flash pairs to guide the optimization [ 14 ] , or treat static lighting as a free-form residual only rather than a term that must be physically modeled [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑对室内环境进行非正式捕捉，并将同时使用静态和主动照明（通过闪光灯照明）来实现更高质量的逆渲染（图 1）。 在我们的设定中，开闪光灯和关闪光灯的图像可能来自不同的视角，且数量也可能不同。 原则上，静态照明和闪光灯照明源具有协同作用，因为两者都能提供材料镜面反射叶的样本。 例如，闪光灯照明可以照亮被静态照明遮挡的区域，而静态照明则能捕捉到仅用闪光灯照明难以观察到的掠射角反射。 闪光灯照明还有助于优化反照率，尤其是在静态照明复杂或非白色时。 要有效利用这些协同机会，需要对静态和主动照明成分进行基于物理的重建；例如，以往的研究会从带闪光灯/无闪光灯的图像对中分离出直接照明以指导优化 [14]，或者仅将静态照明视为自由形式的残差项，而非必须物理建模的要素 [15]。

paragraphs.en: Our core contribution to achieve this synergy is a training time spatial structure that lets us constrain geometry and material properties across lighting conditions. First, consider that we wish to use oriented 2D Gaussian primitives as the underlying representation for reconstruction [ 16 ] because they are fast to optimize and render. Such a flash/no-flash optimization is problematic when using a GS method because a) primitives have no natural neighborhood structure, and b) GS representations have many flexible ways to fake view-dependent appearance. For this, we propose a GS-anchored diffuse field, in which the rasterized 2DGS depth at each pixel is used to query a hash-encoded MLP [ 17 ] for diffuse color. This design significantly improves diffuse and specular decomposition from optimization because it lets us better leverage static lighting images to assist, and still allows the final result to contain only 2DGS primitives for interactive rendering. In comparison to six current methods, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in material estimation and relighting, both in metrics and in visual comparisons across eight scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们实现这种协同作用的核心贡献是一种训练时间空间结构，它使我们能够在不同光照条件下约束几何形状和材料属性。 首先，考虑到我们希望使用定向二维高斯原语作为重建的基础表示 [ 16 ]，因为它们可以快速优化和渲染。 在使用 GS 方法时，这种有闪光灯/无闪光的优化存在一些问题，因为 a) 原语没有自然的邻域结构，b) GS 表示有许多灵活的方式来伪造与视角相关的外观。 为此，我们提出了一种以 GS 为锚点的漫射场，其中每个像素处的光栅化二维 GS 深度被用来查询哈希编码的 MLP [ 17 ]，以获得漫射颜色。 这种设计显著改善了通过优化实现的漫射和镜面分解效果，因为它使我们能更好地利用静态光照图像进行辅助，同时最终结果仍仅包含二维 GS 原语，以实现交互式渲染。 与六种现有方法相比，我们的方法在材料估计和重照明方面达到了当前最先进的性能，无论是在指标上还是在八个场景的视觉比较中均表现优异。

paragraphs.en: This aims to recover geometry, spatially varying materials, and unknown lighting from posed images, but remains highly ambiguous due to the entanglement between reflectance and illumination. Existing methods can be broadly grouped into object-centric and scene-level approaches. For object-centric inverse rendering, recent works have extended 3DGS to relightable reconstruction [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] . For instance, GS-IR [ 23 ] combines Gaussian Splatting with deferred physically based shading, using baked visibility and indirect illumination for efficient relighting. R3DG [ 24 ] associates radiance and reflectance attributes with Gaussians and performs physically based relighting with ray tracing. Follow-up methods further improve reflective appearance modeling and material estimation: Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] introduces mesh-grounded inter-reflection; Ref-GS [ 1 ] uses directional factorization for view-dependent effects; and MaterialRefGS [ 25 ] encourages multi-view consistent material inference. These methods demonstrate the potential of Gaussian representations for static-light inverse rendering, but they commonly rely on simplified or optimized static illumination, making material estimation challenging under complex or partially observed lighting.
paragraphs.zh: 该方法旨在从给定姿态的图像中恢复几何结构、空间变化的材质以及未知光照，但由于反射率与光照之间的相互纠缠，结果仍存在高度歧义。 现有方法大致可分为以物体为中心的方法和场景级方法两类。 在面向物体的逆渲染方面，近期研究已将 3DGS 扩展至可重新打光的重建技术 [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] 。 例如，GS-IR [ 23 ] 将高斯泼溅技术与延迟物理基础着色相结合，利用预烘焙的可见性和间接光照实现高效的重新打光。 R3DG [ 24 ] 将辐射度和反射率属性与高斯分布关联，并通过光线追踪实现基于物理的重新打光。 后续方法进一步改进了反射外观建模和材质估计：Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] 引入了基于网格的相互反射；Ref-GS [ 1 ] 使用方向分解处理与视角相关的效果；而 MaterialRefGS [ 25 ] 则鼓励多视角一致的材质推断。 这些方法展示了高斯表示在静态光照逆渲染中的潜力，但它们通常依赖简化或优化的静态光照，因此在复杂或部分可见的光照条件下，材质估计仍具有挑战性。

sents.en: For instance, GS-IR [ 23 ] combines Gaussian Splatting with deferred physically based shading, using baked visibility and indirect illumination for efficient relighting.

sents.en: Follow-up methods further improve reflective appearance modeling and material estimation: Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] introduces mesh-grounded inter-reflection; Ref-GS [ 1 ] uses directional factorization for view-dependent effects; and MaterialRefGS [ 25 ] encourages multi-view consistent material inference.

sents.en: These methods demonstrate the potential of Gaussian representations for static-light inverse rendering, but they commonly rely on simplified or optimized static illumination, making material estimation challenging under complex or partially observed lighting.
sents.zh: 这些方法展示了高斯表示在静态光照逆渲染中的潜力，但它们通常依赖简化或优化的静态光照，因此在复杂或部分可见的光照条件下，材质估计仍具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: For scene-level inverse rendering, the main difficulty lies in modeling complex indoor illumination. Li et al. [ 6 ] represent large-scale indoor illumination with HDR textures, while MILO [ 7 ] explicitly models multi-bounce light transport in scenes with light-emitting objects. FIPT [ 4 ] and IRIS [ 5 ] further improve scene-level material-lighting estimation with more explicit physically based rendering formulations. Although these methods can produce high-quality results when scene illumination is sufficiently observed or modeled, they still rely solely on static-light observations, where complex illumination can be easily absorbed into material appearance. In contrast, our method complements static-light observations with casually captured flash images, using the active flash residual to provide additional constraints for scene-level Gaussian inverse rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 对于场景级逆渲染，主要困难在于对复杂的室内照明进行建模。Li 等人 [ 6 ] 使用 HDR 纹理来表示大尺度室内照明，而 MILO [ 7 ] 则明确地对包含发光物体的场景中的多次反射光传输进行了建模。 FIPT [ 4 ] 和 IRIS [ 5 ] 通过采用更明确的基于物理的渲染公式，进一步提升了场景级材质与光照的估计效果。 尽管当场景照明得到充分观察或建模时，这些方法能够生成高质量的结果，但它们仍然完全依赖静态光照的观察，而复杂的光照在这种情况下很容易被吸收进材质的外观中。 相比之下，我们的方法通过利用偶然捕捉到的闪光图像来补充静态光照的观察，并使用主动闪光残差为场景级高斯逆渲染提供额外的约束条件。

paragraphs.en: Active-light inverse rendering reduces material-lighting ambiguity by capturing scenes under controlled illumination, such as point lights [ 26 ] , one-light-at-a-time (OLAT) lighting [ 27 ] , area lights [ 28 ] , or LED arrays [ 29 ] . IRON [ 8 ] optimizes neural SDFs and materials from photometric images under point lights, while GS3 [ 10 ] and OLAT Gaussians [ 9 ] extend OLAT-style acquisition to Gaussian-based relightable reconstruction. Other works explore different active-light setups: Gao et al. [ 12 ] use differentiable area-light shading for efficient object reconstruction, and Neural Trace Photography [ 13 ] uses programmable lighting for free-form scanning of non-planar appearance. These methods add constraints for material estimation, but usually require dark-room capture, calibrated lighting devices, or dense active-light measurements, which limit their applicability to casual in-the-wild scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 主动光反向渲染通过捕捉受控光照下的场景来减少材料与光照之间的模糊性，例如点光源 [26]、单次单灯（OLAT）照明 [27]、区域光 [28] 或 LED 阵列 [29]。 IRON [8] 在点光源条件下从光度图像中优化神经 SDF 和材料，而 GS3 [10] 和 OLAT 高斯函数 [9] 则将 OLAT 风格的采集方法扩展到了基于高斯函数的可重照明重建。 其他研究探索了不同的主动光设置：Gao 等人 [12] 使用可微分的区域光着色来实现高效的物体重建，而神经迹摄影 [13] 则利用可编程光照对非平面外观进行自由形式扫描。 这些方法为材料估计增加了约束条件，但通常需要暗室拍摄、经过校准的照明设备或密集的主动光测量数据，这限制了它们在普通野外场景中的应用性。

paragraphs.en: Closest to our setting, WildLight by Cheng et al. [ 15 ] constrains the BRDF physically only through the flashlight differential; ambient appearance is modeled by a free-form neural radiance field that takes BRDF parameters as conditioning but is not physically tied to them. As a consequence, strong ambient cues like sunlight from a window producing specular highlights are absorbed by the ambient network rather than entering the BRDF estimate as a physical constraint. Our method instead grounds ambient observations in a physically-based shading model, so both lighting conditions contribute physical evidence to BRDF recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 与我们的设定最接近的是 Cheng 等人提出的 WildLight。 [ 15 ] 仅通过手电筒的差分来对 BRDF 进行物理约束；环境外观则由一个自由形式的神经辐射场建模，该辐射场将 BRDF 参数作为条件输入，但并未与其存在物理上的绑定关系。 因此，来自窗户的阳光这类会产生镜面高光的环境特征，会被环境网络吸收，而不是作为物理约束进入 BRDF 的估计中。 相比之下，我们的方法将环境观察结果基于一个物理驱动的着色模型，从而使得两种光照条件都能为 BRDF 恢复提供物理证据。

paragraphs.en: Feed-forward methods predict intrinsic or material properties directly from images, avoiding costly per-scene optimization. Early intrinsic decomposition methods estimate albedo and shading from a single RGB image [ 30 ] . Recent diffusion-based models further improve single-image material decomposition: RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X [ 31 ] predicts intrinsic channels such as albedo, roughness, metallicity, and lighting from indoor images. This paradigm has also been extended to multi-view settings. MVInverse [ 32 ] predicts spatially varying materials from multi-view images in a feed-forward manner, while IDArb [ 33 ] handles an arbitrary number of input views and illumination conditions with a diffusion model. DiffusionRenderer [ 34 ] further leverages video diffusion priors to recover G-buffer attributes from in-the-wild videos. These methods are efficient and provide useful material priors, but without scene-specific rendering constraints, their predictions may contain lighting-dependent color casts in albedo and unreliable roughness estimates. Therefore, we use feed-forward material predictions as auxiliary priors rather than using them as the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 前馈方法直接从图像中预测内在属性或材料属性，从而避免了每场景一次的高成本优化。 早期的内在属性分解方法通过单张 RGB 图像估计反照率和阴影 [30]。 近期的扩散模型进一步改进了单图像材料分解：RGB ↔ X [31] 能够从室内图像中预测反照率、粗糙度、金属度和光照等内在通道。 这一范式也已被扩展到多视角设置中。 MVInverse [32] 以前馈方式从多视角图像中预测空间变化的材料，而 IDArb [33] 则通过扩散模型处理任意数量的输入视角和光照条件。 DiffusionRenderer [34] 进一步利用视频扩散先验，从真实场景的视频中恢复 G-buffer 属性。 这些方法效率高且能提供有用的材料先验，但由于缺乏场景特定的渲染约束，其预测结果中的反照率可能包含依赖光照的颜色偏移，粗糙度估计也可能不可靠。 因此，我们将前馈材料预测用作辅助先验，而非最终结果。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 2 , our inverse rendering pipeline begins by employing a hybrid Gaussian splatting and diffuse field representation (Sec. III-C ) to model the scene’s geometry and materials. Building upon the 2DGS framework, we incorporate material features to each primitive, and use a separate GS-anchored diffuse field — a hash-encoded MLP queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth — to ensure multi-view consistency of the diffuse color. With this representation, we use deferred rendering for both static and flash lighting scenarios (Sec. III-D ) and a multi-stage optimization pipeline with loss terms that guide the inverse rendering process (Sec. III-E ).
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2 所示，我们的反向渲染流程首先采用混合高斯泼溅与漫射场表示（第 III-C 节）来对场景的几何形状和材质进行建模。在 2DGS 框架的基础上，我们为每个原始体融入了材质特征，并使用一个独立的高斯泼溅锚定的漫射场——即通过哈希编码的多层感知机（MLP），并在光栅化的 2DGS 深度处进行查询——以确保漫射颜色在多视角下的一致性。基于这种表示方法，我们对静态光照和闪光光照场景均采用了延迟渲染（第 III-D 节），并采用了一个包含多个阶段的优化流程，其中各损失项用于指导反向渲染过程（第 III-E 节）。

paragraphs.en: The flash provides a known localized perturbation of the lighting at each surface point. Subtracting the rendered non-flash image from the captured flash image isolates this perturbation as a residual 𝐂 flash = 𝐂 ˙ − 𝐂 nf \mathbf{C}_{\rm flash}=\dot{\mathbf{C}}-\mathbf{C}^{\rm nf} that separates albedo from incoming radiance. For the residual to drive the decomposition, every other term in the rendering equation must be unable to absorb it. Therefore, the diffuse channel must be a function of world position alone: if the same world point takes different diffuse values from different viewpoints, the optimizer routes the flash signal into that view-dependent capacity instead of the BRDF and lighting terms. While per-Gaussian diffuse parameters are view-consistent in 3D, the effect of rendering many Gaussians from multiple viewpoints is not: a single rasterized pixel mixes contributions from a different set of Gaussians with different alpha-blending weights for each viewpoint, so the diffuse value rasterized at a given world point shifts between views. Under a 1 / r 2 1/r^{2} flash, this shift is on the same scale as the residual we want to recover. Thus, routing the diffuse channel through a GS-anchored diffuse field forces difference between the flash and non-flash captures at the same world point to be attributed to the lighting or specular BRDF terms. Forming this as a multi-resolution hash encoding lets the field carry texture-scale detail at fixed parameter cost and with O(1) look-up.
paragraphs.zh: 闪光在每个表面点处对光照造成了一个已知且局部化的扰动。 将捕捉到的闪光图像减去渲染出的无闪光图像，可将该扰动分离为一个残差 𝐂 flash = 𝐂 ˙ − 𝐂 nf \mathbf{C}_{\rm flash}=\dot{\mathbf{C}}-\mathbf{C}^{\rm nf}，从而将反照率与入射辐射度区分开来。 要使该残差能够驱动分解，渲染方程中的其他所有项都必须无法吸收它。 因此，漫反射通道必须仅作为世界位置的函数：如果同一世界点在不同视角下具有不同的漫反射值，优化器就会将闪光信号路由到这种依赖视角的容量中，而非 BRDF 和光照项中。 尽管每个高斯分布的漫反射参数在三维空间中是视角一致的，但从多个视角渲染多个高斯分布时却并非如此：单个光栅化像素会混合来自不同高斯分布的贡献，而每个视角对应不同的 alpha-混合权重，因此在世界某一点处光栅化的漫反射值会在不同视角间发生偏移。 在遵循 1 / r 2 1/r^{2} 衰减规律的闪光下，这种偏移的幅度与我们希望恢复的残差处于同一量级。 因此，通过将漫反射通道经由一个以 GS 为锚点的漫反射场进行路由，可以确保同一世界点处闪光图像与无闪光图像之间的差异被归因于光照或镜面 BRDF 项。 将其构造成一种多分辨率哈希编码，使得该场能够在固定参数开销下携带纹理尺度的细节，并支持 O(1) 的查找操作。

paragraphs.en: To disentangle the diffuse component from the color, for diffuse color 𝐜 d ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 3 \mathbf{c}^{\mathrm{d}}\in[0,1]^{3} , we remove the spherical harmonics (SH). A similar approach is used in Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] and MaterialRefGS [ 25 ] , which assume that specular variations can be decomposed into view-independent material properties, while the final view-dependent appearance is governed by the BRDF. However, since Gaussians span different pixels and contribute varying weights across viewpoints during alpha blending, material parameters exhibit significant inconsistencies from different perspectives. This inconsistency complicates accurate illumination decomposition, as the BRDF struggles to infer a consistent global physical reflectance effect from such varying material observations.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将漫反射成分与颜色分离，对于漫反射颜色 𝐜 d ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 3 \mathbf{c}^{\mathrm{d}}\in[0,1]^{3}，我们移除球谐函数（SH）。 Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] 和 MaterialRefGS [ 25 ] 也采用了类似的方法，它们假设镜面反射的变化可以分解为与视角无关的材料属性，而最终的视角相关外观则由 BRDF 决定。 然而，由于高斯函数跨越不同的像素，并且在 alpha 混合过程中对各个视角产生不同的权重贡献，因此材料参数在不同视角下表现出显著的不一致性。 这种不一致性使得精确的光照分解变得复杂，因为 BRDF 难以从这些变化的材料观察中推断出一致的全局物理反射率效果。

paragraphs.en: where MLP df \mathrm{MLP_{df}} uses hash encoding. Here, D ⁡ ( 𝐮 ) D(\mathbf{u}) denotes the alpha-blended depth rendered by 2DGS using the same front-to-back compositing weights as in Eq. ( 3 ). We unproject pixel 𝐮 \mathbf{u} with D ⁡ ( 𝐮 ) D(\mathbf{u}) to obtain the world-space position queried by the GADF. Unlike MaterialRefGS, which uses a warping loss between neighboring views to improve multi-view consistency, our GS-anchored diffuse field implicitly ensures view consistency. As shown in Fig. 3 , this design leads to more accurate diffuse and specular decomposition. This solution relies on the rendered depth being multi-view consistent; we achieve this through a depth distortion loss that pushes primitives together (e.g., towards true surfaces), and a normal prior loss. paragraphs.en: Although the other G-buffer attributes are also view-independent in principle, we use the GADF only to represent diffuse color. paragraphs.en: We model the static incident radiance using a set of spatially varying environment maps. paragraphs.en: Our setting is considerably simpler than that of FIPT, as we model only the additional illumination induced by the camera flash rather than general indoor illumination. We therefore simplify the factorization to further reduce the precomputation cost. In particular, we discard indirect radiance originating from regions outside the field of view of the corresponding flash image and retain only the diffuse component of the indirect flash illumination. paragraphs.en: For all experiments, each scene is trained for 25,000 iterations on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. Training is carried out in two stages. In the first stage, we optimize the scene geometry, material properties, and multiple environment maps for 18,000 iterations, utilizing static illumination only. In the second stage, covering iterations 18,000 to 25,000, we enable the flashlight for material optimization, simultaneously refining the material properties, environmental lighting, and flashlight parameters. During the second stage, we set the batch size to two: for each batch, we first sample a non-flash image and then select the nearest flash image based on the camera’s position and orientation. All methods are trained and tested using images with a resolution of 640 × 360 640\times 360 .
paragraphs.zh: 在所有实验中，每个场景都在单块 NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU 上进行 25,000 次迭代训练。 训练分为两个阶段进行。 在第一阶段中，我们仅使用静态光照，对场景几何结构、材质属性以及多个环境贴图进行 18,000 次迭代优化。 在第二阶段（即第 18,000 到 25,000 次迭代期间），我们启用手电筒以优化材质，同时进一步调整材质属性、环境光照和手电筒参数。 在第二阶段中，我们将批量大小设为 2：对于每个批次，我们先采样一张无闪光图像，再根据相机的位置和朝向选择最近的闪光图像。 所有方法均使用分辨率为 640 × 360 的图像进行训练和测试。

sents.zh: 在所有实验中，每个场景都在单块 NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU 上进行 25,000 次迭代训练。

sents.zh: 在第二阶段（即第 18,000 到 25,000 次迭代期间），我们启用手电筒以优化材质，同时进一步调整材质属性、环境光照和手电筒参数。

sents.zh: 在第二阶段中，我们将批量大小设为 2：对于每个批次，我们先采样一张无闪光图像，再根据相机的位置和朝向选择最近的闪光图像。

sents.zh: 所有方法均使用分辨率为 640 × 360 的图像进行训练和测试。

paragraphs.en: During optimization, we use the Adam optimizer [ 40 ] for both the 2DGS and material parameters, following the same learning rates as Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] . For the GS-anchored diffuse field, implemented using an Instant-NGP [ 17 ] network, we use Adam with an initial learning rate of 0.001 0.001 and a delay multiplier of 0.1 0.1 , which gradually reduces the learning rate to 0.0001 0.0001 . The loss-term weights are set to λ n = 0.5 \lambda_{\rm n}=0.5 , λ a = 0.05 \lambda_{\rm a}=0.05 , λ g = 2.0 \lambda_{\rm g}=2.0 , λ dd = 2.0 \lambda_{\rm{dd}}=2.0 , λ da = 0.05 \lambda_{\rm{da}}=0.05 , and λ s = 0.3 \lambda_{\rm s}=0.3 . For the albedo-gradient prior, we use λ g = 2.0 \lambda_{\rm g}=2.0 for all synthetic scenes and λ g = 10.0 \lambda_{\rm g}=10.0 for all real-world scenes. The larger weight for real-world captures is used to compensate for the higher level of capture noise and reconstruction uncertainty. We use the same λ g \lambda_{\rm g} for all scenes within each category and do not tune it separately for individual scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 在优化过程中，我们对 2DGS 和材料参数均使用 Adam 优化器 [40]，并采用与 Ref-Gaussian [2] 相同的学習率。 对于通过 Instant-NGP [17] 网络实现的 GS 锚定漫射场，我们使用 Adam 优化器，初始学習率为 0.001 0.001，延迟乘数为 0.1 0.1，从而将学習率逐步降低至 0.0001 0.0001。 损失项权重设置为 λ n = 0.5 \lambda_{\rm n}=0.5、λ a = 0.05 \lambda_{\rm a}=0.05、λ g = 2.0 \lambda_{\rm g}=2.0、λ dd = 2.0 \lambda_{\rm{dd}}=2.0、λ da = 0.05 \lambda_{\rm{da}}=0.05 以及 λ s = 0.3 \lambda_{\rm s}=0.3。 对于反照率梯度先验，所有合成场景使用 λ g = 2.0 \lambda_{\rm g}=2.0，所有真实世界场景则使用 λ g = 10.0 \lambda_{\rm g}=10.0。 对真实世界采集数据设置更大的权重，是为了补偿其较高的采集噪声和重建不确定性。 在每一类别的所有场景中，我们都使用相同的 λ g \lambda_{\rm g}，而不会针对单个场景单独调整该值。

paragraphs.en: For real-scene experiments, we use a Sony A7M4 camera equipped with a Godox V350S flash. For each scene, we keep the camera exposure settings, white balance, and flash power fixed across all captures, and disable automatic exposure and automatic white-balance adjustments to ensure a consistent photometric response between the flash and non-flash images. The white balance is set to 5500K. All captured images are stored as 8-bit sRGB PNG images. Our shading model computes rendered colors in linear RGB space. Before computing the photometric loss, we convert the rendered linear RGB colors to sRGB so that they are compared with the captured images in the same color space. We do not explicitly estimate a camera response function or mask saturated pixels during optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实场景实验中，我们使用配备 Godox V350S 闪光灯的 Sony A7M4 相机。 对于每个场景，我们在所有拍摄中保持相机的曝光设置、白平衡和闪光灯功率不变，并禁用自动曝光和自动白平衡调整，以确保闪光灯图像与非闪光灯图像之间具有一致的光度响应。 白平衡设置为 5500K。 所有拍摄的图片均以 8 位 sRGB PNG 格式存储。 我们的阴影模型在线性 RGB 空间中计算渲染颜色。 在计算光度损失之前，我们将渲染的线性 RGB 颜色转换为 sRGB，以便在相同的色彩空间中与拍摄的图片进行比较。 我们在优化过程中不会显式估计相机响应函数或掩码饱和像素。

sents.en: For real-scene experiments, we use a Sony A7M4 camera equipped with a Godox V350S flash.
sents.zh: 在真实场景实验中，我们使用配备 Godox V350S 闪光灯的 Sony A7M4 相机。

sents.en: For each scene, we keep the camera exposure settings, white balance, and flash power fixed across all captures, and disable automatic exposure and automatic white-balance adjustments to ensure a consistent photometric response between the flash and non-flash images.
sents.zh: 对于每个场景，我们在所有拍摄中保持相机的曝光设置、白平衡和闪光灯功率不变，并禁用自动曝光和自动白平衡调整，以确保闪光灯图像与非闪光灯图像之间具有一致的光度响应。

sents.zh: 白平衡设置为 5500K。

sents.zh: 所有拍摄的图片均以 8 位 sRGB PNG 格式存储。

sents.zh: 我们的阴影模型在线性 RGB 空间中计算渲染颜色。

sents.zh: 在计算光度损失之前，我们将渲染的线性 RGB 颜色转换为 sRGB，以便在相同的色彩空间中与拍摄的图片进行比较。

sents.en: We do not explicitly estimate a camera response function or mask saturated pixels during optimization.
sents.zh: 我们在优化过程中不会显式估计相机响应函数或掩码饱和像素。

paragraphs.en: During optimization, we assume that the flash is collocated with the camera. Accordingly, for each flash image, we set the flash position 𝐱 l \mathbf{x}_{l} to the corresponding camera center and align the flash centerline direction 𝝎 l \boldsymbol{\omega}_{l} with the camera optical axis. We do not explicitly calibrate the camera-to-flash extrinsic transformation. The robustness to violations of this collocation assumption is evaluated in the ablation study.
paragraphs.zh: 在优化过程中，我们假设闪光灯与相机共置。 因此，对于每张闪光图像，我们将闪光灯位置 𝐱 l \mathbf{x}_{l} 设为对应的相机中心，并将闪光灯中心线方向 𝝎 l \boldsymbol{\omega}_{l} 与相机光轴对齐。 我们没有显式地校准相机到闪光灯的对外变换。 在消融研究中，我们评估了这种共置假设被违反时的鲁棒性。

sents.en: During optimization, we assume that the flash is collocated with the camera.
sents.zh: 在优化过程中，我们假设闪光灯与相机共置。

sents.en: Accordingly, for each flash image, we set the flash position 𝐱 l \mathbf{x}_{l} to the corresponding camera center and align the flash centerline direction 𝝎 l \boldsymbol{\omega}_{l} with the camera optical axis.
sents.zh: 因此，对于每张闪光图像，我们将闪光灯位置 𝐱 l \mathbf{x}_{l} 设为对应的相机中心，并将闪光灯中心线方向 𝝎 l \boldsymbol{\omega}_{l} 与相机光轴对齐。

sents.en: We do not explicitly calibrate the camera-to-flash extrinsic transformation.
sents.zh: 我们没有显式地校准相机到闪光灯的对外变换。

sents.en: The robustness to violations of this collocation assumption is evaluated in the ablation study.
sents.zh: 在消融研究中，我们评估了这种共置假设被违反时的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real-world indoor scenes with unpaired flash and non-flash observations. Our synthetic dataset contains five Blender-rendered scenes, including Kitchen, Office, Market, Livingroom-1, and Livingroom-2. For each synthetic scene, we render 100–150 non-flash images and 100–150 flash images at a resolution of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 . Since the synthetic scenes are generated in Blender, ground-truth material maps are available and used for quantitative material evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在合成和真实世界的室内场景上对我们的方法进行了评估，这些场景包含未配对的闪光和非闪光观测数据。 我们的合成数据集包含五个通过 Blender 渲染的场景，包括厨房、办公室、市场、客厅-1 和客厅-2。 对于每个合成场景，我们以 1280 × 720 的分辨率渲染了 100–150 张非闪光图像和 100–150 张闪光图像 1280\times 720 。 由于这些合成场景是在 Blender 中生成的，因此我们获得了真实材料贴图，并将其用于材料的定量评估。

sents.en: We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real-world indoor scenes with unpaired flash and non-flash observations.
sents.zh: 我们在合成和真实世界的室内场景上对我们的方法进行了评估，这些场景包含未配对的闪光和非闪光观测数据。

sents.en: Our synthetic dataset contains five Blender-rendered scenes, including Kitchen, Office, Market, Livingroom-1, and Livingroom-2.
sents.zh: 我们的合成数据集包含五个通过 Blender 渲染的场景，包括厨房、办公室、市场、客厅-1 和客厅-2。

paragraphs.en: We further capture three real-world scenes, including Coffee bar, Classroom, and Car, using a Sony A7M4 camera equipped with a Godox V350S flash. Each real scene contains 80–100 non-flash images and 80–100 flash images. The camera poses of real scenes are estimated using COLMAP. For all scenes, we use MVInverse [ 32 ] to generate per-view albedo maps and normal maps as auxiliary supervision during training. For real-world scenes, we mainly evaluate material quality through qualitative decomposition and relighting results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步使用配备 Godox V350S 闪光灯的 Sony A7M4 相机，捕捉了三个真实场景，包括咖啡吧、教室和汽车。 每个真实场景包含 80–100 张非闪光图像和 80–100 张闪光图像。 真实场景的相机姿态使用 COLMAP 进行估计。 对于所有场景，我们使用 MVInverse [ 32 ] 生成每视角的反照率图和法线图，作为训练期间的辅助监督。 对于真实场景，我们主要通过定性分解和重照明结果来评估材质质量。

sents.en: We further capture three real-world scenes, including Coffee bar, Classroom, and Car, using a Sony A7M4 camera equipped with a Godox V350S flash.
sents.zh: 我们进一步使用配备 Godox V350S 闪光灯的 Sony A7M4 相机，捕捉了三个真实场景，包括咖啡吧、教室和汽车。

sents.zh: 每个真实场景包含 80–100 张非闪光图像和 80–100 张闪光图像。

sents.zh: 真实场景的相机姿态使用 COLMAP 进行估计。

sents.en: For all scenes, we use MVInverse [ 32 ] to generate per-view albedo maps and normal maps as auxiliary supervision during training.
sents.zh: 对于所有场景，我们使用 MVInverse [ 32 ] 生成每视角的反照率图和法线图，作为训练期间的辅助监督。

sents.en: For real-world scenes, we mainly evaluate material quality through qualitative decomposition and relighting results.
sents.zh: 对于真实场景，我们主要通过定性分解和重照明结果来评估材质质量。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate image reconstruction quality using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS. For synthetic scenes, we assess material estimation using the available ground-truth material maps. For relighting evaluation, we select five sample images and illuminate each with five different point lights as well as an environment map. We then compute the metrics by comparing the rendered relighting images—generated using our G-buffer and SSRT—with the corresponding ground-truth relighting images. For real-world scenes, where ground-truth materials are unavailable, we focus on qualitative evaluation, assessing material plausibility through decomposition results and relighting performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 来评估图像重建质量。 对于合成场景，我们通过可用的真实材料贴图来评估材料估计结果。 在重照明评估中，我们选择五张样本图像，并使用五种不同的点光源以及一张环境贴图对每张图像进行照明。 接着，我们将使用我们的 G-buffer 和 SSRT 生成的重照明渲染图像与对应的真实重照明图像进行比较，从而计算各项指标。 对于没有真实材料信息的现实场景，我们专注于定性评估，通过分解结果和重照明表现来评估材料的合理性。

sents.en: We evaluate image reconstruction quality using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
sents.zh: 我们使用 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 来评估图像重建质量。

sents.en: For synthetic scenes, we assess material estimation using the available ground-truth material maps.
sents.zh: 对于合成场景，我们通过可用的真实材料贴图来评估材料估计结果。

sents.zh: 接着，我们将使用我们的 G-buffer 和 SSRT 生成的重照明渲染图像与对应的真实重照明图像进行比较，从而计算各项指标。

sents.en: For real-world scenes, where ground-truth materials are unavailable, we focus on qualitative evaluation, assessing material plausibility through decomposition results and relighting performance.
sents.zh: 对于没有真实材料信息的现实场景，我们专注于定性评估，通过分解结果和重照明表现来评估材料的合理性。

paragraphs.en: We compare our method with several representative inverse rendering approaches under different reconstruction paradigms. Since WildLight [ 15 ] also exploits active illumination for inverse rendering, it is particularly relevant to our acquisition setting. We therefore include WildLight as a baseline and compare its material decomposition and relighting results with those of our method under similar input conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在不同的重建范式下，将我们的方法与几种具有代表性的逆渲染方法进行了比较。 由于 WildLight [ 15 ] 也利用主动照明进行逆渲染，因此它与我们的采集设置尤为相关。 因此，我们将 WildLight 作为一个基线方法，并在相似的输入条件下，将其材料分解和重照明结果与我们的方法进行比较。

sents.en: We compare our method with several representative inverse rendering approaches under different reconstruction paradigms.
sents.zh: 我们在不同的重建范式下，将我们的方法与几种具有代表性的逆渲染方法进行了比较。

sents.en: Since WildLight [ 15 ] also exploits active illumination for inverse rendering, it is particularly relevant to our acquisition setting.
sents.zh: 由于 WildLight [ 15 ] 也利用主动照明进行逆渲染，因此它与我们的采集设置尤为相关。

sents.en: We therefore include WildLight as a baseline and compare its material decomposition and relighting results with those of our method under similar input conditions.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将 WildLight 作为一个基线方法，并在相似的输入条件下，将其材料分解和重照明结果与我们的方法进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We further compare with Gaussian-based reflective reconstruction methods, including Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] and MaterialRefGS [ 25 ] . For a fair comparison, both methods are provided with ground-truth segmentation masks and the corresponding segmentation loss. Since MaterialRefGS already incorporates its own normal prior loss, we additionally apply the same normal prior loss used in our method to Ref-Gaussian.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还与基于高斯分布的反射重建方法进行了进一步比较，包括 Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] 和 MaterialRefGS [ 25 ]。 为了进行公平比较，两种方法都被提供了真实分割掩码以及相应的分割损失。 由于 MaterialRefGS 已经包含了其自身的法线先验损失，因此我们对 Ref-Gaussian 额外应用了与我们方法中相同的法线先验损失。

sents.en: We further compare with Gaussian-based reflective reconstruction methods, including Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] and MaterialRefGS [ 25 ] .
sents.zh: 我们还与基于高斯分布的反射重建方法进行了进一步比较，包括 Ref-Gaussian [ 2 ] 和 MaterialRefGS [ 25 ]。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate our method on five synthetic scenes with available ground-truth material maps. Since the compared methods support different output representations and target different tasks, we evaluate each method based on the predictions it produces. For Ref-Gaussian and MaterialRefGS, we compare the estimated diffuse color, roughness, and normal maps. For WildLight, MVInverse, FIPT, and IRIS, we compare the estimated albedo and roughness maps, as well as the relighting results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在五个具有可用真实材料图的合成场景上评估我们的方法。 由于所比较的方法支持不同的输出表示形式并针对不同的任务，因此我们根据每种方法生成的预测结果进行评估。 对于 Ref-Gaussian 和 MaterialRefGS，我们比较了估计的漫反射颜色、粗糙度和法线贴图。 对于 WildLight、MVInverse、FIPT 和 IRIS，我们比较了估计的反照率和粗糙度贴图，以及重新照明结果。

paragraphs.en: For relighting, we use Blender’s SSRT renderer with the per-view G-buffers predicted by our method. We adopt SSRT for its efficiency and compatibility with Blender. Since our method does not reconstruct complete geometry, ray tracing may introduce artifacts in regions with incomplete geometry. In contrast, SSRT operates directly on the rendered G-buffers and is therefore more robust to such incompleteness.
paragraphs.zh: 在重新布光时，我们使用 Blender 的 SSRT 渲染器，并结合由我们的方法预测出的每视角 G-buffer。 我们采用 SSRT，因为它高效且与 Blender 兼容。 由于我们的方法并未重建完整的几何结构，光线追踪可能会在几何结构不完整的区域引入伪影。 相比之下，SSRT 直接对渲染后的 G-buffer 进行操作，因此对这类不完整性的容忍度更高。

paragraphs.en: Table I presents the quantitative comparison of our method with the baselines on the synthetic dataset. Our method achieves more accurate diffuse color, albedo, and roughness estimation, demonstrating improved material decomposition across diverse scenes. Moreover, our method significantly outperforms all other approaches in relighting quality. This consistent improvement suggests that the additional flashlight information helps our method better disentangle material, geometry, and illumination, thereby reducing the inherent ambiguities that often degrade relighting quality. Our method also achieves competitive runtime efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 表 I 展示了我们的方法与基线方法在合成数据集上的定量比较。 我们的方法在漫射颜色、反照率和粗糙度估计上实现了更高的准确性，证明了其在不同场景下对材料分解能力的提升。 此外，我们的方法在重照明质量方面显著优于所有其他方法。 这种持续性的改进表明，额外的闪光灯信息有助于我们的方法更好地分离材料、几何结构和光照，从而减少通常会导致重照明质量下降的固有模糊性。 我们的方法还实现了具有竞争力的运行效率。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the robustness of our method to imperfect segmentation, we additionally replace the ground-truth segmentation masks with per-view masks generated by SAM2 [ 41 ] , denoted as “Ours-SAM2”. Despite using generated segmentation masks, Ours-SAM2 still outperforms the other methods in diffuse color, albedo, and relighting. Its roughness estimation is slightly worse than that of IRIS, although IRIS is provided with ground-truth segmentation masks. These results demonstrate that our method remains effective without relying on ground-truth 2D segmentation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们的方法在分割不完美情况下的鲁棒性，我们还用 SAM2 [41] 为每个视图生成的掩码替换了真实分割掩码，并将其称为“Ours-SAM2”。 尽管使用了生成的分割掩码，Ours-SAM2 在漫反射颜色、反照率和重照明方面仍然优于其他方法。 其粗糙度估计略逊于 IRIS，尽管 IRIS 获得了真实分割掩码。 这些结果表明，我们的方法无需依赖真实的二维分割也能保持有效。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 and 5 present qualitative comparisons of material decomposition and relighting on representative synthetic scenes. Our method produces more accurate and consistent albedo maps, faithfully capturing the base colors of objects without contamination from shading or specular highlights, as illustrated by the right cabinet door in the kitchen scene and the display cabinet in the market scene. It also achieves the most accurate relighting results, with specular highlights that closely match the ground truth in both spatial distribution and intensity.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 和图 5 展示了在代表性合成场景中对材料分解和重照明效果的定性比较。 我们的方法能够生成更准确、更一致的漫反射系数图，忠实地捕捉物体的基础颜色，且不受阴影或镜面高光的影响，如厨房场景中右侧的柜门以及市场场景中的展示柜所示。 该方法还实现了最精确的重照明效果，其镜面高光在空间分布和强度上都与真实数据高度吻合。

paragraphs.en: For real-world captures, ground-truth material annotations are unavailable. We therefore mainly provide qualitative comparisons of material decomposition and relighting (Fig. 6 ). Specifically, we visualize rendered RGB images, diffuse color or albedo, roughness, normal maps, and relighting results when supported by each method. These comparisons are used to evaluate whether each method can recover physically plausible materials and generalize to novel flash illumination. As shown in Fig. 6 , for the Coffee Bar scene, our method successfully recovers diffuse materials, such as the fabric of the armchair, as well as specular components, including the chair legs, floor, and table. This improvement is particularly evident in the roughness map, where our results exhibit more accurate and coherent material properties. For the Classroom scene, our method also successfully estimates the specular properties of the whiteboard. Moreover, by leveraging flash images, our method more faithfully recovers the albedo of the wooden podium floor, whereas MVInverse suffers from noticeable color shifts in these regions. For the Car scene, our method also produces plausible albedo and roughness estimates. Notably, our method accurately identifies the black region on the left side of the car window as plastic, which is clearly reflected in the roughness map. As a result, for real-world scenes, our method achieves high-quality material estimation, enabling effective relighting, as shown in the rightmost column.

paragraphs.en: We conduct ablation studies to validate the contribution of each component of our method (Table II ). Each variant is obtained by removing or replacing one component of the full model while keeping all other settings unchanged. As shown in Table II , in the first part of the ablation study, we evaluate different configurations, including the presence or absence of flashlight input and GADF. The results demonstrate that flashlight images significantly improve albedo and roughness estimation. Removing the flashlight input slightly improves diffuse-color PSNR by 0.07 dB. This may be because the flashlight primarily provides additional cues for material estimation rather than diffuse-color reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了消融研究，以验证我们方法中每个组件的贡献（表 II）。 每个变体都是通过移除或替换完整模型中的一个组件而获得的，同时保持所有其他设置不变。 如表 II 所示，在消融研究的第一部分，我们评估了不同的配置，包括是否包含手电筒输入和 GADF。 结果表明，手电筒图像显著提升了反照率和粗糙度的估计效果。 移除手电筒输入后，漫反射颜色的 PSNR 略有提升，增加了 0.07 dB。 这可能是因为手电筒主要提供了用于材料估计的额外线索，而非用于漫反射颜色重建。

paragraphs.en: Next, we perform an ablation study on the individual loss terms. Removing the normal prior loss decreases the quality of the predicted normals, which in turn affects material estimation. Removing the albedo loss degrades albedo estimation but has relatively little impact on roughness. The specular decomposition loss substantially improves roughness estimation, while the semantic loss provides a smaller but consistent improvement. In Fig. 7 , we present qualitative comparisons of the ablation variants on the Kitchen scene. The visual results are consistent with the quantitative results in Table II , further demonstrating the effectiveness of our key components and loss terms.

paragraphs.en: One limitation of our method is that, compared with one-light-at-a-time methods, it is not sufficiently sensitive to subtle changes in roughness. Moreover, in regions that are overexposed even without flash illumination, our method may lose constraints and produce noisy material estimates. In future work, we plan to explore the use of RAW image formats and camera response function (CRF) modeling to better handle overexposed regions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们方法的一个局限性是，与一次仅处理一个光线的传统方法相比，它对粗糙度的细微变化不够敏感。 此外，在没有闪光照明的情况下就已经过曝的区域，我们的方法可能会失去约束，并产生带有噪声的材料估计结果。 在未来的工作中，我们计划探索使用 RAW 图像格式和相机响应函数（CRF）建模，以更好地处理过曝区域。

paragraphs.en: We introduced a practical inverse rendering framework for casually captured indoor scenes, where material and geometry estimation are challenging due to complex scene structure, diverse reflectance properties, occlusions, and indirect light transport. Our key insight is to combine flash and non-flash images as complementary physical cues for more reliable material decomposition. Based on this insight, our method integrates physically based static and flash rendering with a view-consistent diffuse representation. Across synthetic and real-world scenes, our approach improves material decomposition and relighting quality over recent baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种实用的反向渲染框架，用于处理随意捕捉的室内场景。由于场景结构复杂、反射特性多样、存在遮挡以及间接光传输，材料估计和几何形状估计在这些场景中极具挑战性。 我们的关键思路是将闪光图像与非闪光图像结合，作为互补的物理线索，以实现更可靠的材料分解。 基于这一思路，我们的方法将基于物理的静态渲染与闪光渲染相结合，并引入一种视角一致的漫反射表示。 在合成场景和真实世界中，我们的方法相较于近期的基线模型，在材料分解和重照明质量方面均有提升。

sents.en: Across synthetic and real-world scenes, our approach improves material decomposition and relighting quality over recent baselines.
